events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam's 54th
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday on Monday! What's your favourite tune from the legendary Mancunian?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album released
events.blurb: John Lennon's second solo album, 'Imagine', featuring his signature song, was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine 55th Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 55 years since John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine'. A song that still inspires peace and reflection around the world.

events.title: First Apple iPod released
events.blurb: The first Apple iPod, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket', was unveiled on October 23, 2001, and became available for purchase on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: iPod 25th Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's been 25 years since Apple unveiled the original iPod, revolutionising how we all listened to music.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is Global James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred) to 007 and over six decades of iconic cinema.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, the legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's 86th
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. A true legend of music and an enduring voice for peace.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Cleese's 87th
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A double LP that pushed boundaries and remains a masterpiece. What's your standout track?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45, from complications due to AIDS.

angles.name: Freddie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on December 3, 1965, in the UK.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years ago today, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that marked a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed on December 8, 1980, outside his New York City residence.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day 46 years ago, the music world lost a giant. Remembering John Lennon, whose legacy continues to inspire generations.
